items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: That's what Big Al Louie used to say when he used to hire me.

ctx.x: I was a jazz fiddler. Sometimes fellas used to think of the clarinet. That's what Big Al Louie used to say when he used to hire me. Come, little lady, say, I thought there was a clarinet. You know, wait, Bill, you'd have that fiddle going. You know Big Al Louie, don't you?

I knew him very well. I made some records of him before he died. And dead 10 years will be this year. I was going to ask about some of the best musicians you ever heard on the different instruments. We might start with violin. Who was the best violin player down, or were there two or three of the best ones? Who were your favorites that you heard in New Orleans? You liked that.
